questions.skill: Represent nonlinear constraints and judge viable options
questions.standard_level: Algebra II. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Algebra II, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: A garden has length L and width W (feet). The fencing for L + W is 30 ft and the area must be at least 200 ft². Write the constraints, find the viable widths, and decide whether W = 8 is viable.
questions.prompt_markup: A garden has length L and width W (feet). The fencing for L + W is 30 ft and the area must be at least 200 ft². Write the constraints, find the viable widths, and decide whether W = 8 is viable.
questions.correct_answer: L + W = 30 and LW ≥ 200; 10 ≤ W ≤ 20; W = 8 is not viable
questions.grading_note: Form required: constraints, the interval, and the decision. W(30 - W) ≥ 200.
